err_validation: Check model selection and path to llama.exe!
err_no_model: No heavy weights file found in the selected model folder!
desc_gpu: Layers on GPU (999 — all, 0 — CPU only).
desc_batch: Physical batch size for VRAM optimization.
desc_ubatch: Physical mini-batch size for VRAM optimization.
desc_flash: Flash Attention (on — enable, off — disable, auto — core choice).
desc_topk: Limit token selection to K most probable options.
desc_presence: Topic repetition penalty to force new ideas.
desc_specmax: Maximum length of speculative draft chain.
desc_tensor: Split model layers across multiple GPUs.
desc_port: Network port for local API deployment (default 3090).
desc_alias: Unique model alias for API requests (automatically uses the folder name).
desc_n_cpu_moe: Number of experts to evaluate on the CPU for MoE models
desc_jinja: Enable Jinja templating for prompt processing.
desc_cont_batching: Enable continuous batching for improved performance.
desc_minp: Minimum token probability threshold for nucleus sampling.
desc_cache_type_k: Cache type for K (key) tensors in KV cache.
desc_cache_type_v: Cache type for V (value) tensors in KV cache.
